name: coreutils-small-08

deferred_intrinsics.reason: C2Rust 0.22.1 panics on the x86_64 GNU inline-assembly constraints emitted through factor's arithmetic helpers, including e and %1. Preserve the optimized canonical path for a typed asm/GMP bridge rather than hand-editing generated Rust.

selection_policy: The next measured-smallest canonical archives after batch seven whose captured translation units contain neither SELinux nor systemd support. Date and du are kept in separate batches because both capture show-date.c under distinct applet configurations. Factor moved to the typed inline-assembly/GMP bridge queue after both raw translator passes reproduced C2Rust's constraint-parser panic; stty substitutes here. Previously isolated shared-source families basenc and unexpand can now advance without same-batch C2Rust deduplication.
